name: Lava Gem
body:
Price 50 gp; Slot none CL 1st; Weight —; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

Made from the solidified breath weapon of a ruby dragon, this small ruby can be thrown or used as a sling bullet. It shatters at impact, releasing a small quantity of lava that deals 1d6 points of fire damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 25 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells lava droplets
